description: Na₅Li₃V₈O₂₄ is Esseneite-like structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.60 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.62 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.63 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six VO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent LiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.38 Å. There are two inequivalent Li sites. In the first Li site, Li is bonded to six O atoms to form LiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six VO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent LiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.30 Å. In the second Li site, Li is bonded to six O atoms to form LiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six VO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one LiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.19-2.30 Å. There are four inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three LiO₆ octahedra and corners with two VO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 33-60°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.67-1.83 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent LiO₆ octahedra, and corners with two VO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 33-62°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.67-1.83 Å. In the third V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one LiO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and corners with two VO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 36-64°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.66-1.83 Å. In the fourth V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three LiO₆ octahedra and corners with two VO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 34-60°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.67-1.83 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Li, and one V atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Li, and one V atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Li, and one V atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₂LiV trigonal pyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Li, and one V atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two V atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Li, and one V atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Li, and one V atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two V atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to two Na and one V atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two V atoms. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Li, and one V atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two V atoms.
